queries_run: DexCom largest customer second source OR in-house 2026
DexCom single-source supplier risk customer diversify 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因子：DXCM 對單一來源零件難以快速建立替代供應商（供應端風險，非客戶端導入第二供應商）；搜尋未見最大客戶（經銷商）導入第二供應商或自製的來源。
findings.excerpt: If there are regulatory delays or impediments impacting our suppliers or us for any reason, we may not be able to quickly establish additional or replacement suppliers, particularly for our single-source components, in part because of the custom nature of various parts we design.

findings.claim: Reuters 經 Stockopedia：DexCom 向 FDA 提交基於 Silicon Labs 晶片的申請，分析師解讀為在 Nordic Semiconductor 之外增加第二供應商（供應端雙源）
findings.source: Stockopedia/Reuters: Nordic Semi falls as DexCom filing raises dual-sourcing concerns

customer_second_source.note: 客戶端（經銷商）導入第二供應商/自製：搜尋無來源。Q3 2026 10-Q 顯示經銷商占絕大部分營收但未點名。另有 Reuters 經 Stockopedia 報導 DXCM 向 FDA 申請 Silicon Labs 晶片（對 Nordic 的供應端雙源），屬供應端，列為 clue。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
